content: Yerɑ sinɑ boko kɑ Hɑmɑni bɑ Ɛsitɛɛn tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ dim mɛ dɑ nɔn yiruse.
Ye bɑ dim kpɑ bɑ tɑm nɔrumɔ, yerɑ sinɑ boko u mɑɑ Ɛsitɛɛ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ ɑ kĩ ɑ mɑn kɑnɑ. Nɑ sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ n kɑ nun kpuro kuɑ ye ɑ kĩ. Kon mɑm nun nɛn tem bɔnu wɛ̃.
Mɑ Ɛsitɛɛ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ̀ n kɑ mɑn nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛrɑn nɑ, mɑ n nun wɛ̃re, wee ye nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ. A ku de bu nɛ kɑ nɛn bweseru ɡo.
Domi bɑ sun dɔrɑwɑ bu kɑ sun sɑkiri bu kpeerɑsiɑ wɔnwɔndu sɑriru sɔɔ. Ǹ n yorun nɑ bɑ sun kpɛ̃ɛ, kon dɑɑ nɛn nɔɔ mɑriwɑ domi tɑ ǹ turɑ n kɑ nun bɑɑsi.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko Asuresi u Ɛsitɛɛ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u niɑ yen bweseru kuɑ.
Ɛsitɛɛ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɛsɛn yibɛrɛ wi u sun nɔni sɔ̃ɔmɔ, wiyɑ Hɑmɑni tɔn kɔ̃so wini. Yerɑ Hɑmɑni u nɑndɑ sinɑ boko kɑ Ɛsitɛɛn wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u seewɑ u yɑrɑ kɑ mɔru u dɑ win sinɑ kpɑɑrun yɑɑrɑɔ. Sɑɑ yerɑ Hɑmɑni u tubɑ mɑ sinɑ boko u sɔɔru kpɑwɑ u kɑ nùn ɡo. Yerɑ u Ɛsitɛɛ suuru kɑnɑ u nùn fɑɑbɑ ko.

Mɑ u tii yɔ̃su u wɔrumɑ mi Ɛsitɛɛ u sɔ̃. Sɑɑ yerɑ sinɑ boko u wurɑmɑ mɑ u duɑ mi bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru dimɔ. Yerɑ u Hɑmɑni bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kĩ ɑ mɑɑ Ɛsitɛɛ ɡɑbɑwɑ nɛn wuswɑɑɔ sinɑ kpɑɑru mini? U kɑ ɡɑri yi ɡere u kpe, yerɑ win sɔm kowobu bɑ Hɑmɑnin wuswɑɑ bɔkuɑ.

Yerɑ sɔm kowo ben turo wi bɑ mɔ̀ Hɑɑbonɑ u sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, Hɑmɑnin tii u dɑ̃ru ɡɑru sɔɔru kuɑ tè sɔɔ u koo rɑɑ Mɑɑdose sɔku u bwɛ̃ wi u nun ɡɑri dɔmɛyɑ ɑ kɑ fɑɑbɑ wɑ mi. Dɑ̃ɑ te, tɑ ɡire mi, win dirun wuswɑɑɔ. Ten ɡunum mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu weerɑɑkuru. Yerɑ sinɑ boko u woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, bu Hɑmɑni sɔkuo bu bwɛ̃ dɑ̃ɑ te sɔɔ.
Mɑ bɑ Hɑmɑni suɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ bɑ bwɛ̃ dɑ̃ɑ ten wɔllɔ, te u rɑɑ sɔɔru kuɑ Mɑɑdosen sɔ̃. Sɑɑ yerɑ sinɑ bokon mɔru yɑ sure.
